pairs.subject: data-access
pairs.evidence: src/athena/wiring.py:157 The composition root and its tool executors reach the brain only through the store's named operations (write_fact, append_episode, live_episode_ids, counts), so this context issues no query against the store and can add no writer to it.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/wiring.py:157 The write_fact executor calls a named store operation with plain values and does not re-state the provenance rule; it turns the store's ProvenanceError into validator_failed.
src/athena/wiring.py:352 Checking many cited episode ids is one batched set call (the store answers an empty list without querying), not a lookup per id.
tests/test_cli.py:212 CLI tests run against a real Brain/SQLite on a per-test tmp_path and check the rebuilt store, with no mocked store.
src/athena/cli.py:133 The markdown tree is named as the authority and the index as derived. reconcile rebuilds the index from disk, and doctor reports orphan index rows as a warning.
src/athena/cli.py:104 The only statement in this context is a fixed capability probe on a throwaway :memory: connection. It has no values or identifiers to bind and never touches the store.
src/athena/wiring.py:167 This context only consumes typed refs that the store has already decoded. Row decoding happens in core.brain.store, outside this context.
src/athena/wiring.py:323 The root builds one concrete store class. No second backend sits behind an interface here, so there is no parity to keep.
